parameters.query: INSERT INTO rag.corpus_versions (version, status, document_count, chunk_count, embedding_profile_id, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'staging', $2, $3, $4, now()) ON CONFLICT (version) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO rag.documents (corpus_version, source_name, source_hash, chunk_index, content, embedding, embedding_profile_id) SELECT $1, source_name, source_hash, chunk_index, content, embedding::vector, embedding_profile_id FROM unnest($2::jsonb[]) ... ON CONFLICT (corpus_version, source_hash, chunk_index) DO NOTHING

BEGIN; UPDATE rag.corpus_versions SET status='superseded' WHERE status='active'; UPDATE rag.corpus_versions SET status='active' WHERE version=$1; UPDATE rag.rag_settings SET active_corpus_version=$1; COMMIT;
